# Raterunner - Knowledge Base

> Live currency, crypto, FX rates for 180+ currencies.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- 180+ fiat currencies live
- 5000+ cryptocurrencies
- KRW base support
- Historical charts 5 years

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://raterunner.online/
